students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Manage student accounts and enrollment records.
students.name: Full Name
students.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep current password.

hints.name: Required. Student's full name as it should appear on official documents.
hints.email: Required. Used for login and must be unique — no two accounts can share the same email.
hints.username: Required. Used for login alongside email and must also be unique.
hints.password: Required. At least 8 characters. Students can change it later from their account.
hints.passwordHint: Optional. Leave empty to keep current password — fill only to set a new one.
hints.gender: Required. Used for records and for directing the student to gender-specific facilities when needed.
hints.birthDate: Optional. Used to calculate age and verify eligibility for the selected grade level.
hints.nationalId: Only required if available, depending on school policy. Used for official identification.
hints.phone: Optional. Direct contact number for the student, if available.
hints.active: Controls login access. Disable to prevent the student from logging in without archiving the record.
hints.academicYear: Required. The academic year the student is enrolled in — determines the available classes below.
hints.currentClass: Optional until assigned to a class. Only classes belonging to the selected academic year appear.
hints.admissionDate: Required. The date the student officially joined the school.
hints.admissionNumber: Optional. Leave empty for auto-generation based on the academic year.
hints.rollNumber: Optional. Internal number used in class attendance rolls.
hints.scholarshipPercentage: Optional. The discount percentage applied to this student's tuition, from 0 to 100.
hints.isGraduated: Indicates the student has completed their studies. Leave unchecked for currently enrolled students.
hints.fatherName: Optional. Used for correspondence and emergency contacts.
hints.fatherPhone: Optional. Direct contact number for the student's father.
hints.motherName: Optional. Used for correspondence and emergency contacts.
hints.motherPhone: Optional. Direct contact number for the student's mother.
hints.guardianName: Optional. Fill if the primary guardian is someone other than the parents.
hints.guardianPhone: Optional. Direct contact number for the guardian.
hints.guardianRelation: Optional. Guardian's relationship to the student, e.g., uncle or grandfather.
hints.address: Optional. Student's residential address, for correspondence and records.
hints.city: Optional. The city where the student resides.
hints.bloodGroup: Optional. Recorded only for medical emergencies.
hints.allergies: Optional but recommended. List any known allergies that staff should be aware of.
hints.medicalConditions: Optional but recommended. Any medical conditions relevant to the student's care at school.
hints.previousSchool: Optional. Name of the school the student previously attended, if any.
hints.emergencyContactName: Recommended. The person to contact first in case of a medical or security emergency.
hints.emergencyContactPhone: Recommended. A reachable number for the emergency contact.
hints.emergencyContactRelation: Optional. The emergency contact's relationship to the student.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Manage classes and sections.
classes.name: Class Name
classes.search: Search by name or section code
classes.empty: No classes yet. Add your first class to get started.
classes.confirmArchive: Archive this class? An administrator can restore it later.
classes.noStudents: No students enrolled in this class yet.

hints.name: Required. Display name for the class, e.g., "Grade 3" or "Science A".
hints.sectionCode: Required. Short code identifying the section, e.g., "A" or "1". Must be unique within the same academic year and grade level.
hints.capacity: Required. Maximum number of students this class can accommodate. Must be at least 1.
hints.academicYear: Required. The academic year this class belongs to — determines available section codes.
hints.gradeLevel: Required. The grade level this class teaches.
hints.branch: Required. The school branch where this class is held — determines available classrooms below.
hints.classroom: Optional. The classroom assigned to this class. Only classrooms belonging to the selected branch appear.
hints.classTeacher: Optional. The teacher primarily responsible for this class.
hints.assistantTeacher: Optional. An assistant teacher supporting the class teacher.
hints.active: Controls whether the class is available for new enrollments. Disable to hide it without archiving.

branch.title: Branches
branch.subtitle: Manage school branches and locations
branch.code_already_exists: A branch with this code already exists.

hints.name: Required. Full name of the branch.
hints.address: Optional. Physical address of the branch.
hints.city: Optional. City where the branch is located.
hints.phone: Optional. Contact phone number for the branch.
hints.manager_id: Optional. User responsible for managing this branch.
hints.is_main: Designate this as the main branch of the school.
hints.is_active: Branch is operational and available for use.
hints.latitude: Optional. GPS coordinates (latitude) for the branch location.
hints.longitude: Optional. GPS coordinates (longitude) for the branch location.
